subject: FY 2016 Budget Adoption
overview: The City Council approved the FY 2016 municipal budget, addressed bodywork establishment regulations, and received a MassDOT presentation on the Cradock Bridge reconstruction project.

items.title: Cradock Bridge Reconstruction Presentation
items.summary: MassDOT and contractor representatives presented details and traffic staging for the multi-year Cradock Bridge replacement project, and the council voted to require monthly progress updates and a dedicated contact person.

items.title: Medford High School Swim Team Presentation
items.summary: The council received and placed on file a presentation by Medford High School swim coach Mary Judge thanking the council for pool refurbishments and donating swim-a-thon proceeds to the Buddy Coholan Adult Day Health Center.

items.title: Regulation of Bodywork Establishments
items.summary: Referred a proposed ordinance based on Plymouth's model to the Board of Health, City Solicitor, and state delegation to license and regulate bodywork establishments following neighborhood complaints.

items.title: Cleaning and Dyeing Licenses
items.summary: Approved a cleaning and dyeing license for Forest Street Dry Cleaners and tabled two other license applications.

items.title: FY 2016 Municipal Budget
items.summary: Approved the FY 2016 operating budget of approximately $155 million after rejecting an amendment to reduce the sewer appropriation.

items.title: Outreach Agent for Substance Abuse Position
items.summary: Ordained the classification amendment establishing the position of Outreach Agent for Substance Abuse.

items.title: Medical Marijuana Zoning Amendment
items.summary: Referred a proposed zoning ordinance governing the siting and location restrictions for medical marijuana treatment centers and dispensaries to the Planning Board.

items.title: Community Access Television
items.summary: Received and placed on file a discussion regarding the status and location of community access television.

items.title: Condolences and Memorial Recognitions
items.summary: Passed resolutions offering condolences to the families of Merle Lindsay, Vincent Guerra, and Dennis Figalski, and held a moment of silence for George Kahan and the deceased.
